**Coaching note for the club player:**

When your opponent has pawns pinned to their king on the back rank (here g7 and f7), look for forcing checks that exploit those pins. Bxf7+ works because the f7 pawn is pinned—Black cannot recapture with it. If Black moves the king to h8, Qh7 is checkmate (the queen is protected by your bishop). This combination of pin + forcing check + back-rank mate is a classic pattern worth memorizing.
